pattern.short_summary: The user designates a sub-extent of the artifact and the generative operation applies to exactly that extent.
pattern.definition: The user designates a sub-extent of the artifact and the generative operation applies to exactly that extent. What lies outside the designation is not rewritten. The mark carries no content of its own: it says where, not what.
pattern.structural_signature: The artifact admits addressing of proper sub-extents (a text selection, a painted mask, a stroke set, a pane, a spatial region). A designation act records one such extent as the current scope; the operation's write set is bounded by it and the complement is held fixed; the result is composited back into the original at the marked position. The scope is re-designatable and the operation is otherwise the same regardless of which extent is chosen.

dimension.category_description: How users inspect, modify, scope, revise, accept, program, or interrupt generated work at the artifact level.
